title: Determining the frequency of thyroid parameter measurements following rhTSH administration in a healthy, older population
author: Zutinic, Blauw, et al.
materials: Laboratory measurements were performed after all subjects had completed the study. All measurements were performed with the same lot number. For each participant, samples from the different time points were measured in the same batch. Assays and assay performance are reported in detail elsewhere [13]. In short, all measurements were performed with fully automated, software monitored equipment and diagnostics from Roche Diagnostics (Almere, The Netherlands) at the Department of Clinical Chemistry and Laboratory Medicine at Leiden University Medical Centre, The Netherlands. Thyroid parameters TSH (Catalogue number 11731459122, research reference identifier (RRID): AB_2756377), fT4 (Catalogue number 6437281190, RRID: AB_2801661), T4 (Catalogue number 12017709122, RRID: AB_2756378), fT3 (Catalogue number 6437206190, RRID: AB_2827368) and T3 (Catalogue number 11731360122, RRID: AB_2827369) were measured in serum by an immunoassay using Roche cobas8000 with an E602 module.

steps.title: Place IV cannula and baseline draw
steps.instruction: Insert an intravenous cannula into a forearm vein of the participant, draw a baseline blood sample, and prepare for rhTSH injection.

steps.title: Administer rhTSH intramuscularly
steps.instruction: Inject 0.1 mg/mL rhTSH (1 mL) into the gluteal muscle; record the exact time as time zero.

steps.title: Collect serial blood samples
steps.instruction: Obtain blood at the specified intervals after rhTSH injection and provide standardized meals.

substeps.instruction: First hour: draw blood every 15 minutes.
Provide two standardized meals (600 kcal each; 2 × 125 mL Nutridrink Compact, Nutricia Advanced Medical Nutrition) at 2 h and 5 h post‑injection.
Study days 2–4: obtain fasted blood samples at 24 h, 48 h, and 72 h after injection.

steps.title: Process serum samples
steps.instruction: Allow collected blood to clot, centrifuge, aliquot, and store serum under defined conditions.

substeps.instruction: Let serum clot at room temperature for 60 minutes.
Centrifuge tubes for 10 minutes at 2350 g, 20 °C.
Store aliquots at –20 °C, then move to permanent storage at –80 °C until analysis.

steps.title: Measure thyroid parameters
steps.instruction: Run all stored serum samples in batch using Roche cobas8000 with E602 module, employing the same reagent lot for each participant.
